children.value: > Fact From Story | FTX was a fraud “from the start,” the Securities and Exchange Commission alleges — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > Fact From Story | Those privileges ultimately resulted in Alameda owing FTX $8 billion worth of customer deposits.
> > > Fact From Story | Wang told the court about the advantages that Alameda received by having code baked into FTX's software that allowed special access to the crypto exchange.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | Special access can be used to misappropriate funds.
> > Fact From Story | Wang told the court about the advantages that Alameda received by having code baked into FTX's software that allowed special access to the crypto exchange.
> > Commonsense Knowledge | Misappropriating customer funds is a type of fraud.
> Fact From Story | Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story | Wang didn’t exactly help himself out, either.

> > > Fact From Story | Wang testified that Alameda got access to a special credit line and an option to take its balance into the negative without triggering liquidation — something he alleged other accounts at FTX didn’t get. | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story | "We ultimately took about $14 billion, some of which we were not able to pay back.” | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | A trial is held when someone is accused of something they may have done wrong. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge | People on trial are accused of something.
> Commonsense Knowledge | Wire fraud and conspiracy are types of fraud.
